It works for any current Claude model as the target:</p><div data-not-prose="true" class="overflow-hidden rounded-card border bg-surface-2 group relative"><div data-copy-scope="" It asks you to confirm the migration scope (entire working directory, a subdirectory, or a specific file list) before editing any files. The skill also detects Amazon Bedrock and Claude Platform on AWS clients and adjusts model ID formats and feature changes for those platforms.</p></div></aside>
<p>This page lists the code changes for moving to Claude Opus 5.5 from <a href="#migrating-from-claude-opus-5">Claude Opus 5</a>, <a href="#migrating-from-claude-opus-4-8">Claude Opus 4.8</a>, <a href="#migrating-from-claude-opus-47">Claude Opus 4.7</a>, <a href="#migrating-from-claude-opus-46">Claude Opus 4.6 and earlier Opus models</a>, or <a href="#migrating-from-claude-sonnet-5">Claude Sonnet 5</a>. Every reader needs <a href="#request-requirements">What every request to Claude Opus 5.5 must satisfy</a> and <a href="#thinking-in-every-response">Handle thinking in every response</a>. Then go to the section for your current model: its first sentence names the other sections that apply to you. The <a href="#migration-checklist">migration checklist</a> lists every change by starting model.</p>
<p>Claude Opus 5.5 costs less than Claude Opus 5 ($4 / $20 USD per million input / output tokens, compared with $5 / $25; see <a href="/docs/en/about-claude/pricing">Claude pricing</a>). For feature support, see <a href="/docs/en/models/opus-5-5/whats-new-opus-5-5#feature-support">What&#x27;s new in Claude Opus 5.5</a>. For behavioral differences and model-specific prompting patterns, see <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/prompting-claude-opus-5-5">Prompting Claude Opus 5.5</a>.</p>
<h2 id="request-requirements" class="group">What every request to Claude Opus 5.5 must satisfy<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2176aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h2>
<p>Whichever model you are coming from, a request to <code>claude-opus-5-5</code> must meet the following. Where an item says a setting is rejected, the API returns a 400 error.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Model ID:</strong> Use <code>claude-opus-5-5</code>, a fixed model ID with no date suffix. On Amazon Bedrock, Claude Platform on AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Foundry, use that platform&#x27;s model ID; see <a href="/docs/en/models/opus-5-5/whats-new-opus-5-5#availability">Availability</a>.</li>
<li><strong>Thinking:</strong> Send no <code>thinking</code> field, or send <code>thinking: {&quot;type&quot;: &quot;adaptive&quot;}</code>, which is equivalent: <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking">adaptive thinking</a> is always on. <code>thinking: {&quot;type&quot;: &quot;disabled&quot;}</code> and manual thinking budgets (<code>thinking: {&quot;type&quot;: &quot;enabled&quot;, &quot;budget_tokens&quot;: N}</code>) are rejected. See the <a href="#thinking-cant-be-disabled">before and after for thinking</a>.</li>
<li><strong>Effort:</strong> Control thinking depth with the <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/effort">effort parameter</a>, the only request parameter that controls it. All five levels (<code>low</code>, <code>medium</code>, <code>high</code>, <code>xhigh</code>, <code>max</code>) are supported, and the default is <code>medium</code>. See <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/effort#recommended-effort-levels-for-claude-opus-5-5">Recommended effort levels for Claude Opus 5.5</a>.</li>
<li><strong>Tool choice:</strong> Use <code>tool_choice</code> <code>{&quot;type&quot;: &quot;auto&quot;}</code> (the default) or <code>{&quot;type&quot;: &quot;none&quot;}</code>. Forcing a tool call with <code>{&quot;type&quot;: &quot;any&quot;}</code> or <code>{&quot;type&quot;: &quot;tool&quot;, &quot;name&quot;: &quot;...&quot;}</code> is rejected. See the <a href="#forced-tool-use">before and after for tool choice</a>.</li>
<li><strong>Sampling parameters:</strong> Omit <code>temperature</code>, <code>top_p</code>, and <code>top_k</code>, or leave them at their defaults: any other value is rejected. Use prompting to guide the model&#x27;s behavior.</li>
<li><strong>Prefill:</strong> Don&#x27;t end <code>messages</code> with a prefilled assistant turn: it is rejected. Use <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/structured-outputs">structured outputs</a> or system prompt instructions instead. On Amazon Bedrock, structured outputs aren&#x27;t available for Claude Opus 5.5, so use system prompt instructions there.</li>
<li><strong>Computer use:</strong> On the Claude API and Google Cloud, declare computer use as the <code>computer_toolset_20260801</code> toolset; the earlier <code>computer_20251124</code> tool is rejected there. See the <a href="#computer-use-toolset">computer use breaking change</a>.</li>
<li><strong>Context window:</strong> No context-window beta header is needed. The <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows">1M token context window</a> is the default, and a header sent for older models has no effect.</li>
</ul>
<p>The following request satisfies every item in the list: effort is set, and there is no <code>thinking</code> field. The SDK tabs that print text select it by block type, because <code>thinking</code> blocks come first.</p>

<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">    output_config</span><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#f3f7f6">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#f3f7f6">{</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">"effort"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#f3f7f6">: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">"medium"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#f3f7f6">},</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#f3f7f6">)</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">for</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#f3f7f6"> block </span><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">in</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#f3f7f6"> response.content:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">    if</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#f3f7f6"> block.type </span><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#f3f7f6">==</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178"> "text"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#f3f7f6">:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA">        print</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#f3f7f6">(block.text)</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div></div></div>
<h2 id="thinking-in-every-response" class="group">Handle thinking in every response<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_22f6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h2>
<p><span id="breaking-changes-2"></span>Thinking runs on every Claude Opus 5.5 request, so every response can begin with <code>thinking</code> blocks, and <code>max_tokens</code> covers thinking plus text. If your code already runs with thinking on, items 1 to 3 are likely in place: check items 4 and 5. If it ran without thinking, on any earlier model, each item is a change.</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong><code>max_tokens</code> covers thinking plus text:</strong> On Claude Opus 4.8 and earlier Opus models, requests without a <code>thinking</code> field run without thinking. Claude Opus 5 and Claude Sonnet 5 accept <code>thinking: {&quot;type&quot;: &quot;disabled&quot;}</code>. On Claude Opus 5.5, every request runs with <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking">adaptive thinking</a>. <code>max_tokens</code> remains a hard limit on total output, thinking plus response text, so revisit it for workloads that ran without thinking. Thinking tokens are billed as output tokens even when the thinking text is not returned to you, so such a workload can produce more output tokens per request. See <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking-steering-and-cost#cost-control">Cost control</a>. To spend fewer tokens on thinking, lower the <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/effort">effort</a> level. If you run at <code>xhigh</code> or <code>max</code> effort, set a large <code>max_tokens</code> so the model has room to think and act; start at 64k tokens and tune from there. If your prompts were tuned for running without thinking, see <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/prompting-claude-opus-5-5#prompts-written-for-thinking-disabled">Prompts written for thinking disabled</a>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Responses begin with thinking blocks:</strong> A response can begin with one or more <code>thinking</code> blocks before the first <code>text</code> block. Code that reads the reply by position, such as <code>content[0].text</code> or a stream handler that treats the first <code>content_block_start</code> event as text, breaks on these responses. Select content blocks by their <code>type</code> field instead: read <code>text</code> from the blocks whose <code>type</code> is <code>&quot;text&quot;</code>, and branch on the block type when handling stream events.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Return thinking blocks unmodified in tool-use loops:</strong> If you run a tool-use loop, pass the <code>thinking</code> blocks from each assistant response back to the API complete and unmodified when you return tool results, including blocks whose <code>thinking</code> field is empty. Echo the assistant message as received rather than filtering its content blocks by type or rebuilding it: the API rejects edited, reordered, or partially dropped thinking blocks with a 400 error. See <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking#preserving-thinking-blocks">Preserving thinking blocks</a>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Thinking text is omitted by default:</strong> <code>thinking.display</code> defaults to <code>&quot;omitted&quot;</code>, so <code>thinking</code> blocks arrive with an empty <code>thinking</code> field alongside their <code>signature</code>. Treat the <code>thinking</code> field as display text only. To receive readable summaries instead, set <code>thinking.display</code> to <code>&quot;summarized&quot;</code>:</p>

See <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking#controlling-thinking-display">Controlling thinking display</a>.</p>

<li>

See <a href="#text-between-tool-calls">Text between tool calls is returned in thinking blocks</a>.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="migration-checklist" class="group">Migration checklist by starting model<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2376aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h2>
<p>Work down the groups and stop after the one that names your current model: every item up to that point applies to you. If you are on Claude Opus 5, the first group is the whole list. If you are on Claude Sonnet 5, apply the first group and the last.</p>
<h3 id="migration-checklist-from-claude-opus-5" class="group">Every starting model<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_23n6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>
<ul>
<li>Update the model ID to <code>claude-opus-5-5</code>.</li>
<li>Remove <code>thinking: {&quot;type&quot;: &quot;disabled&quot;}</code> and <code>thinking: {&quot;type&quot;: &quot;enabled&quot;, ...}</code>; choose an effort level instead.</li>
<li>Set <code>effort</code> explicitly: the default is <code>medium</code>, where Claude Opus 5&#x27;s is <code>high</code>.</li>
<li>Replace <code>tool_choice</code> types <code>any</code> and <code>tool</code> with <code>auto</code> plus strict tool use or structured outputs, or with <code>auto</code> alone on Amazon Bedrock.</li>
<li>If you use computer use on the Claude API or Google Cloud, declare <code>computer_toolset_20260801</code> (no beta header) instead of <code>computer_20251124</code> and update your agent loop for the toolset. On Amazon Bedrock, keep <code>computer_20251124</code>; check the computer use tool&#x27;s <a href="/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/computer-use-tool#compatibility">Compatibility</a> section for other platforms.</li>
<li>If a router or fallback can move a conversation from Claude Opus 5.5 to another model, expect that model to run without Claude Opus 5.5&#x27;s thinking blocks (Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 on the Claude API are the exception and keep them). Claude Opus 5.5 itself reads thinking from Claude Opus 5, from earlier Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku models, and, on the Claude API and Google Cloud, from Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Haiku 5.5, but not from Claude Fable or Claude Mythos models.</li>
<li>Read content blocks by <code>type</code>, and pass <code>thinking</code> blocks back unmodified in tool-use loops.</li>
<li>If your interface renders text between tool calls, set <code>display: &quot;updates&quot;</code> (beta) or <code>&quot;summarized&quot;</code> and render the non-empty <code>thinking</code> blocks.</li>
<li>If your code edits earlier turns, the <code>system</code> prompt, or <code>tools</code> mid-conversation, follow <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/preserved-thinking">Preserved thinking</a>.</li>
<li>Handle <code>stop_reason: &quot;refusal&quot;</code> and configure fallback.</li>
<li>Re-baseline cost and latency at your chosen effort level.</li>
<li>If your code disabled thinking, revisit <code>max_tokens</code>, which covers thinking plus response text; at <code>xhigh</code> or <code>max</code> effort, start at 64k. See <a href="#thinking-in-every-response">Handle thinking in every response</a>.</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="migration-checklist-from-claude-opus-4-8" class="group">Claude Opus 4.8 or earlier<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2476aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>
<ul>
<li>Review workloads that ran without a <code>thinking</code> field: on Claude Opus 5.5 they run with thinking, and thinking can&#x27;t be disabled. Revisit <code>max_tokens</code>, which remains a hard limit on total output (thinking plus response text), and lower <code>effort</code> where you want less thinking. Thinking tokens are billed as output tokens, so these workloads can produce more output tokens per request.</li>
<li>Verify any code that parses the <code>thinking</code> field treats it as display text only. Set <code>display: &quot;summarized&quot;</code> to receive readable summaries.</li>
<li>Review prompts near the caching minimum: prompts of 512 tokens or more can create cache entries.</li>
<li>If your organization has a <a href="/docs/en/api/service-tiers#supported-models">Priority Tier</a> commitment, plan capacity separately: Priority Tier is not supported on Claude Opus 5.5.</li>
<li>If you run at <code>xhigh</code> or <code>max</code> effort, raise <code>max_tokens</code> to at least 64k as a starting point.</li>
<li>For agentic workloads, consider <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/task-budgets">task budgets</a> (beta) and mid-conversation tool changes (beta).</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="migration-checklist-from-claude-opus-47" class="group">Claude Opus 4.7 or earlier<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_24n6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>
<ul>
<li><span id="migration-checklist-2"></span>Run a fresh <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/effort">effort</a> sweep on your own evals rather than carrying over a setting tuned for an earlier model.</li>
<li>Remove any context-window beta header.</li>
<li>If you rebuild conversation history to update instructions, consider switching to a mid-conversation system message to preserve prompt cache hits.</li>
<li>Verify your stop-reason handling reads <code>stop_details</code> on refusals.</li>
<li>If you want fast mode, which Claude Opus 4.7 rejects, set <code>speed: &quot;fast&quot;</code> with the <code>fast-mode-2026-02-01</code> beta header on the Claude API.</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="migration-checklist-from-claude-opus-46" class="group">Claude Opus 4.6 or earlier<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2576aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>
<ul>
<li><span id="migration-checklist-3"></span>Remove <code>temperature</code>, <code>top_p</code>, and <code>top_k</code> from request payloads.</li>
<li>Replace <code>thinking: {&quot;type&quot;: &quot;enabled&quot;, &quot;budget_tokens&quot;: N}</code> with <code>thinking: {&quot;type&quot;: &quot;adaptive&quot;}</code> plus the <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/effort">effort parameter</a>, or remove the <code>thinking</code> field entirely; adaptive thinking is always on.</li>
<li>If your UI displays thinking content, explicitly opt in to thinking summarization.</li>
<li>Re-benchmark end-to-end cost and latency under the updated tokenization.</li>
<li>Re-tune <code>max_tokens</code> to account for the updated tokenization, including compaction triggers.</li>
<li>Re-test any client-side token-count estimations.</li>
<li>If your application sends images, re-budget for <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/vision#high-resolution-image-support-on-claude-opus-4-7">high-resolution image support</a> (up to approximately 3x more image tokens per full-resolution image). Downsample before sending if you do not need the additional fidelity.</li>
<li>If you consume pointing or bounding-box coordinates from the model, remove any scale-factor conversion; coordinates are 1:1 with actual image pixels on Claude Opus 4.7 and later models.</li>
<li>Review the <a href="#behavior-changes">behavior changes</a> that began in Claude Opus 4.7.</li>
<li>If your product does legitimate security work, apply to the <a href="https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14604842-real-time-cyber-safeguards-on-claude-opus-and-sonnet" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Cyber Verification Program</a> for access to lower restrictions on cyber content.</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="migration-checklist-from-claude-opus-45" class="group">Claude Opus 4.5 or earlier<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_25n6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>
<ul>
<li><span id="migration-checklist-from-claude-opus-4-5-or-earlier"></span>Remove any assistant-message prefills; Claude Opus 4.6 already rejects them.</li>
<li>Verify tool call JSON parsing uses a standard JSON parser.</li>
<li>Move from <code>client.beta.messages.create()</code> to <code>client.messages.create()</code>: adaptive thinking and effort need no beta namespace.</li>
<li>Remove the <code>effort-2025-11-24</code> beta header (the effort parameter does not require it).</li>
<li>Remove the <code>fine-grained-tool-streaming-2025-05-14</code> beta header.</li>
<li>Remove the <code>interleaved-thinking-2025-05-14</code> beta header (adaptive thinking enables interleaved thinking automatically).</li>
<li>Migrate <code>output_format</code> to <code>output_config.format</code> (if applicable).</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="migration-checklist-from-claude-4-1-or-earlier" class="group">Claude 4.1 or earlier<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2676aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>
<ul>
<li>Update tool versions (<code>text_editor_20250728</code>, <code>code_execution_20260521</code>).</li>
<li>Handle the <code>refusal</code> stop reason.</li>

<h3 id="migration-checklist-from-claude-sonnet-5" class="group">Claude Sonnet 5 only<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_26n6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>

<h2 id="migrating-from-claude-opus-5" class="group">Migrating to Claude Opus 5.5 from Claude Opus 5<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2776aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h2>
<p>First work through <a href="#request-requirements">What every request to Claude Opus 5.5 must satisfy</a> and <a href="#thinking-in-every-response">Handle thinking in every response</a>. Every starting model needs the changes in this section. They are the request settings that Claude Opus 5.5 rejects and the response changes that come with it. The checklist for this section is the first group of the <a href="#migration-checklist">migration checklist</a>.</p>
<h3 id="update-your-model-name" class="group">Update your model name<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_27n6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>

<p><code>claude-opus-5-5</code> is a fixed model ID with no date suffix, the same scheme as <code>claude-opus-5</code>. On Amazon Bedrock, Claude Platform on AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Foundry, use that platform&#x27;s model ID; see <a href="/docs/en/models/opus-5-5/whats-new-opus-5-5#availability">Availability</a>.</p>
<h3 id="breaking-changes" class="group">Breaking changes<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_28f6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>
<p>Each change is explained in <a href="/docs/en/models/opus-5-5/whats-new-opus-5-5#breaking-changes">What&#x27;s new in Claude Opus 5.5</a>; this section gives the code change for each.</p>
<h4 id="thinking-cant-be-disabled" class="group">Thinking can&#x27;t be disabled<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_28v6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h4>
<p><code>thinking: {&quot;type&quot;: &quot;disabled&quot;}</code> and <code>thinking: {&quot;type&quot;: &quot;enabled&quot;, &quot;budget_tokens&quot;: N}</code> both return a 400 error (<code>&quot;thinking.type.disabled&quot; is not supported for this model.</code> or <code>&quot;thinking.type.enabled&quot; is not supported for this model.</code>). Remove the <code>thinking</code> field and pick an <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/effort">effort</a> level; where you disabled thinking to save tokens, use a lower one. Responses then begin with <code>thinking</code> blocks, so select content blocks by <code>type</code> and pass <code>thinking</code> blocks back unmodified with tool results. See <a href="/docs/en/models/opus-5-5/whats-new-opus-5-5#thinking-cant-be-disabled">Thinking can&#x27;t be disabled</a>.</p>
<p>Before. Claude Opus 5 accepts this request, and Claude Opus 5.5 rejects it with a 400 error:</p>

<h4 id="forced-tool-use" class="group">Forced tool use is not supported<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2af6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h4>
<p><code>tool_choice</code> types <code>any</code> and <code>tool</code> return a 400 error (<code>tool_choice: type &quot;tool&quot; and &quot;any&quot; are not supported for this model.</code>), including on the token counting endpoint. Use <code>auto</code> with <a href="/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/strict-tool-use">strict tool use</a> or <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/structured-outputs">structured outputs</a>, and say in the prompt when the tool applies. Strict tool use accepts a subset of JSON Schema, so check each tool&#x27;s <code>input_schema</code> before you add <code>strict: true</code>. Every object in the schema must set <code>additionalProperties: false</code>; see <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/structured-outputs#json-schema-limitations">JSON Schema limitations</a>. On Amazon Bedrock, structured outputs, which include strict tool use, aren&#x27;t available for Claude Opus 5.5. There, send <code>auto</code> without <code>strict</code>, say in the prompt when the tool applies, and validate the tool input in your code. See <a href="/docs/en/models/opus-5-5/whats-new-opus-5-5#forced-tool-use-is-not-supported">Forced tool use is not supported</a>.</p>
<p>Before. Claude Opus 5 accepts this request, and Claude Opus 5.5 rejects it with a 400 error:</p>

<h4 id="thinking-blocks" class="group">Thinking blocks are tied to the model and the conversation<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2bv6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h4>
<p>On the Claude API, Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 read Claude Opus 5.5 thinking blocks; no other model does. A router or fallback that moves a conversation from Claude Opus 5.5 to any other model runs those turns without them. In the other direction, Claude Opus 5.5 reads thinking blocks from Claude Opus 5, from earlier Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku models, and, on the Claude API and Google Cloud, from Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Haiku 5.5, but not from Claude Fable or Claude Mythos models. Keep the conversation append-only (no edits to the <code>system</code> prompt, <code>tools</code>, or earlier messages mid-conversation) so the blocks stay valid; Claude Code, claude.ai, Claude Managed Agents, and the Claude Agent SDK already do. Enforcement matches Claude Fable 5.1 on every platform: for accounts created on or after August 31, 2026, 00:00 UTC, replaying a thinking block after such an edit returns a 400 error by default. There is no code change for append-only integrations. See <a href="/docs/en/models/opus-5-5/whats-new-opus-5-5#thinking-blocks-are-tied-to-the-model-that-produced-them">Thinking blocks are tied to the model and the conversation</a> and <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/preserved-thinking">Preserved thinking</a>.</p>
<h4 id="computer-use-toolset" class="group">The <code>computer_20251124</code> computer use tool is not supported on the Claude API and Google Cloud<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2cf6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h4>
<p>On the Claude API and Google Cloud, a <code>tools</code> entry of type <code>computer_20251124</code> returns a 400 error (<code>&#x27;claude-opus-5-5&#x27; does not support tool types: computer_20251124.</code>, followed by the tool types the model accepts). Declare the <code>computer_toolset_20260801</code> toolset instead: drop the beta header and send the entry with no <code>name</code> or display dimensions. In your agent loop, handle member <code>tool_use</code> blocks (the action is the block&#x27;s <code>name</code>, not <code>input.action</code>), several of them per turn, and echo <code>toolset_name</code> on every result. The request change is shown below; the agent-loop changes are listed in <a href="/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/computer-use-tool#migrate-from-computer-20251124">Migrate from <code>computer_20251124</code></a>. On Amazon Bedrock, the earlier <code>computer_20251124</code> tool continues to work on Claude Opus 5.5 as it does on Claude Opus 5, so no change is needed there; for other platforms, see the computer use tool&#x27;s <a href="/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/computer-use-tool#compatibility">Compatibility</a> section. See <a href="/docs/en/models/opus-5-5/whats-new-opus-5-5#computer-20251124-is-not-supported">The <code>computer_20251124</code> computer use tool is not supported on the Claude API and Google Cloud</a>.</p>
