<h3 id="text-between-tool-calls" class="group">Text between tool calls is returned in thinking blocks<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2dv6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>
<p>On Claude Opus 5, text the model writes between tool calls comes back as <code>text</code> blocks. On Claude Opus 5.5, as on Claude Fable 5.1, that narration comes back as <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking#progress-updates">progress-update <code>thinking</code> blocks</a>, at most one before each tool call. At the default <code>thinking.display</code> of <code>&quot;omitted&quot;</code>, their <code>thinking</code> field is empty. No request fails, but an application that streams that text to its users as progress updates goes quiet between tool calls. To restore the updates, read them from <code>thinking</code> blocks and set a <code>display</code> value that returns their text: <code>&quot;updates&quot;</code> (beta, <code>thinking-display-updates-2026-08-18</code> header) returns the progress updates while reasoning stays hidden, and <code>&quot;summarized&quot;</code> returns both, mixed together. Then render each non-empty <code>thinking</code> block ahead of the <code>tool_use</code> block it precedes, and pass the blocks back unchanged with the rest of the assistant turn. See <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/prompting-claude-opus-5-5#user-facing-progress-updates">User-facing progress updates</a>.</p>
<h3 id="safety-classifiers-and-fallback" class="group">Safety classifiers and fallback<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2ef6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>
<p>Claude Opus 5.5 can return <code>stop_reason: &quot;refusal&quot;</code> with a <code>stop_details</code> category. Its classifiers cover a broader set of categories than Claude Opus 5&#x27;s, so expect <code>stop_details.category</code> values such as <code>&quot;bio&quot;</code> in addition to <code>&quot;cyber&quot;</code> and <code>&quot;reasoning_extraction&quot;</code>; see the <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/refusals-and-fallback#refusal-response">refusal category table</a>. Handle refusals and configure <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/refusals-and-fallback#server-side-fallback">server-side fallback</a> or your own retry (server-side fallback doesn&#x27;t retry requests declined with <code>&quot;reasoning_extraction&quot;</code>; that refusal is returned to you); see <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/refusals-and-fallback">Refusals and fallback</a> and <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/prompting-claude-opus-5-5#safeguard-refusals">Safeguard refusals</a>.</p>
<h3 id="recommended-changes" class="group">Recommended changes<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2ev6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>
<ol>
<li><strong>Re-run your effort sweep.</strong> Effort is the only thinking control on Claude Opus 5.5, and its default is <code>medium</code> where Claude Opus 5&#x27;s is <code>high</code>, so a request that omits <code>effort</code> now runs at <code>medium</code>. Step down where quality holds, and step up for the most demanding work. See <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/effort">Effort</a>.</li>
<li><strong>Re-evaluate model-specific prompt instructions.</strong> Instructions tuned for Claude Opus 5&#x27;s behavior may no longer be needed; see <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/prompting-claude-opus-5-5">Prompting Claude Opus 5.5</a>. If you ran with thinking disabled, also see <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/prompting-claude-opus-5-5#prompts-written-for-thinking-disabled">Prompts written for thinking disabled</a>.</li>
<li><strong>Test in a development environment</strong> before switching production traffic.</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="migrating-from-claude-opus-4-8" class="group">Migrating to Claude Opus 5.5 from Claude Opus 4.8<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2ff6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h2>
<p><span id="migrating-from-claude-opus-4-8-to-claude-opus-5"></span>First work through <a href="#request-requirements">What every request to Claude Opus 5.5 must satisfy</a>, <a href="#thinking-in-every-response">Handle thinking in every response</a>, and <a href="#migrating-from-claude-opus-5">Migrating to Claude Opus 5.5 from Claude Opus 5</a>. Use <code>claude-opus-4-8</code> as the model ID you replace. That last section applies to code on Claude Opus 4.8 as written, because Claude Opus 4.8, like Claude Opus 5:</p>
<ul>
<li>Accepts <code>thinking: {&quot;type&quot;: &quot;disabled&quot;}</code>, forced tool choice, and the <code>computer_20251124</code> tool.</li>
<li>Returns the text between tool calls as <code>text</code> blocks.</li>
<li>Defaults to <code>high</code> effort.</li>
</ul>
<p>This section adds what changed between Claude Opus 4.8 and Claude Opus 5. For a checklist, see the first two groups of the <a href="#migration-checklist">migration checklist</a>.</p>
<h3 id="what-changed-from-claude-opus-4-8" class="group">What changed<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2gf6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Thinking runs on requests that omitted it:</strong> On Claude Opus 4.8, thinking is off unless you ask for it. On Claude Opus 5.5, a request with no <code>thinking</code> field runs with thinking, so every item in <a href="#thinking-in-every-response">Handle thinking in every response</a> is a change for that code. If your code never sent a <code>thinking</code> field, there is nothing to remove under the <a href="#thinking-cant-be-disabled">before and after for thinking</a>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Lower prompt caching minimum:</strong> The minimum cacheable prompt length on Claude Opus 5.5 is 512 tokens, down from 1,024 tokens on Claude Opus 4.8. Prompts that were too short to cache on Claude Opus 4.8 can create cache entries, with no code changes required. See <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-caching#cache-limitations">Prompt caching</a> for per-model minimums.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Priority Tier is not supported:</strong> <a href="/docs/en/api/service-tiers#supported-models">Priority Tier</a> is not supported on Claude Opus 5.5, while Claude Opus 4.8 keeps it. If your organization has a Priority Tier commitment, plan capacity separately.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="recommended-changes-from-claude-opus-4-8" class="group">Recommended changes<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2gv6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>
<p><span id="recommended-changes-2"></span>These are not required but will improve your experience:</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Consider task budgets (beta):</strong> For agentic workloads, <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/task-budgets">task budgets</a> tell the model how many tokens it has for a full agentic loop. They require the <code>task-budgets-2026-03-13</code> beta header.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Consider mid-conversation tool changes (beta):</strong> Mid-conversation tool changes let you add or remove tools between turns of a conversation without invalidating <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-caching">prompt cache</a> hits on earlier turns. Changing the <code>tools</code> array itself invalidates the cached prefix. On the Claude API, send the <code>inline-tools-2026-09-15</code> beta header. The older <code>mid-conversation-tool-changes-2026-07-01</code> header still works for changes that name a tool by reference, on the Claude API, Amazon Bedrock, and Google Cloud.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="migrating-from-claude-opus-47" class="group">Migrating to Claude Opus 5.5 from Claude Opus 4.7<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2hn6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h2>
<p>First work through <a href="#request-requirements">What every request to Claude Opus 5.5 must satisfy</a>, <a href="#thinking-in-every-response">Handle thinking in every response</a>, <a href="#migrating-from-claude-opus-5">Migrating to Claude Opus 5.5 from Claude Opus 5</a>, and <a href="#migrating-from-claude-opus-4-8">Migrating to Claude Opus 5.5 from Claude Opus 4.8</a>. Use <code>claude-opus-4-7</code> as the model ID you replace. Those sections apply to code on Claude Opus 4.7 as written. Like Claude Opus 4.8, it accepts <code>thinking: {&quot;type&quot;: &quot;disabled&quot;}</code>, forced tool choice, and the <code>computer_20251124</code> tool. It defaults to <code>high</code> effort and runs without thinking unless you ask for it.</p>
<p><span id="update-your-model-name-2"></span>This section adds what changed after Claude Opus 4.7. If your code is on Claude Opus 4.6 or earlier, continue with <a href="#migrating-from-claude-opus-46">Migrating to Claude Opus 5.5 from Claude Opus 4.6 and earlier Opus models</a> after this section. It adds the breaking changes that took effect in Claude Opus 4.7. For a checklist, see the first three groups of the <a href="#migration-checklist">migration checklist</a>.</p>
<h3 id="what-changed-from-claude-opus-47" class="group">What changed<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2if6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>
<p><span id="what-changed"></span>None of these items adds a breaking change to those in the earlier sections; they are worth checking after you swap the model ID.</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Effort levels recalibrated:</strong> The token allocation behind each effort level changes on Claude Opus 5.5 compared to Claude Opus 4.7. The default is <code>medium</code>, where Claude Opus 4.7&#x27;s is <code>high</code>. Run a fresh effort sweep on your own evals rather than carrying over a setting tuned for Claude Opus 4.7. See <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/effort">Effort</a>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>1M context window is the default:</strong> Claude Opus 5.5 serves the full 1M token <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows">context window</a> by default with no beta header. If your client passes a context-window beta header for compatibility with older models, remove it.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Mid-conversation system messages:</strong> On the Claude API, Amazon Bedrock, and Google Cloud, Claude Opus 5.5 accepts <code>role: &quot;system&quot;</code> messages immediately after a user turn in the <code>messages</code> array (subject to <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/mid-conversation-system-messages#limitations">placement rules</a>). Use the top-level <code>system</code> field for instructions that apply from the start. Claude Opus 4.7 rejects <code>role: &quot;system&quot;</code> in <code>messages</code> with a 400 error. If you maintain code paths that rebuild the full message history to update instructions, you can simplify them and preserve <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-caching">prompt cache</a> hits on earlier turns.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Refusal stop details:</strong> When the model declines a request, Claude Opus 5.5 returns a <code>stop_details</code> object that names the category of refusal, alongside the <code>refusal</code> stop reason. Claude Opus 4.7 returns the same object, so this matters only if your stop-reason handling does not read it yet. No beta header is required, and there is no opt-out. If your stop-reason handling doesn&#x27;t read it yet, see <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/handling-stop-reasons">Handling stop reasons</a>. Claude Opus 5.5 declines in more categories; see <a href="#safety-classifiers-and-fallback">Safety classifiers and fallback</a>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Fast mode:</strong> Claude Opus 5.5 supports <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/fast-mode">fast mode</a> (research preview) on the Claude API. Fast mode is not available on Claude Opus 4.7, where requests with <code>speed: &quot;fast&quot;</code> return an error. Set <code>speed: &quot;fast&quot;</code> with the <code>fast-mode-2026-02-01</code> beta header.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Computer use toolset and browser use tool:</strong> On the Claude API and Google Cloud, Claude Opus 5.5 supports <a href="/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/computer-use-tool">computer use</a> as the <code>computer_toolset_20260801</code> toolset and the <a href="/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/browser-use-tool">browser use tool</a> for tasks inside webpages. Claude Opus 4.7 supports neither. On those platforms Claude Opus 5.5 doesn&#x27;t accept the earlier <code>computer_20251124</code> tool; see the <a href="#computer-use-toolset">computer use breaking change</a>.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="migrating-from-claude-opus-46" class="group">Migrating to Claude Opus 5.5 from Claude Opus 4.6 and earlier Opus models<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2j76aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h2>
<p>First work through every earlier section, in page order. They are <a href="#request-requirements">What every request to Claude Opus 5.5 must satisfy</a>, <a href="#thinking-in-every-response">Handle thinking in every response</a>, and the sections for <a href="#migrating-from-claude-opus-5">Claude Opus 5</a>, <a href="#migrating-from-claude-opus-4-8">Claude Opus 4.8</a>, and <a href="#migrating-from-claude-opus-47">Claude Opus 4.7</a>. Those sections apply to code on Claude Opus 4.6 as written. Like Claude Opus 4.7, it accepts <code>thinking: {&quot;type&quot;: &quot;disabled&quot;}</code>, forced tool choice, and the <code>computer_20251124</code> tool. It defaults to <code>high</code> effort and runs without thinking unless you ask for it. Claude Opus 4.5 and earlier Opus models also accept <code>thinking: {&quot;type&quot;: &quot;disabled&quot;}</code> and forced tool choice, and run without thinking unless you ask for it, so those sections apply to them too.</p>
<p><span id="update-your-model-name-3"></span>This section adds what changed in Claude Opus 4.7, with <code>claude-opus-4-6</code> as the model ID you replace. Its two subsections add what changed before that, for readers on <a href="#migrating-from-claude-opus-45">Claude Opus 4.5 or earlier</a> and <a href="#migrating-from-claude-4-1-or-earlier">Claude 4.1 or earlier</a>. For a checklist, see the <a href="#migration-checklist">migration checklist</a> up to the group that names your model.</p>
<h3 id="opus-46-breaking-changes" class="group">Breaking changes<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2jv6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Extended thinking removed:</strong> <code>thinking: {&quot;type&quot;: &quot;enabled&quot;, &quot;budget_tokens&quot;: N}</code> is no longer supported on Claude Opus 4.7 and later models and returns a 400 error. Switch to <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking">adaptive thinking</a> (<code>thinking: {&quot;type&quot;: &quot;adaptive&quot;}</code>) and use the <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/effort">effort parameter</a> to control thinking depth. On Claude Opus 5.5, adaptive thinking is always on: <code>thinking: {&quot;type&quot;: &quot;adaptive&quot;}</code> is valid and equivalent to omitting the <code>thinking</code> field entirely.</p>
<p>Before (Claude Opus 4.6):</p>

<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#953800;--shiki-dark:#9CDCFE">    messages</span><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#f3f7f6">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#f3f7f6">[{</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">"role"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#f3f7f6">: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">"user"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#f3f7f6">, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">"content"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#f3f7f6">: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178">"..."</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#f3f7f6">}],</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#f3f7f6">)</span></span></code></pre></div></div></div></div></div>
<p><span id="choosing-an-effort-level"></span>Adaptive thinking is steerable through prompting and the <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/effort">effort parameter</a>, which replaces the thinking budget as the way to control how much the model reasons. Run an effort sweep on your own evals rather than translating a <code>budget_tokens</code> value. The <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/effort#effort-levels">effort levels table</a> describes when to use each level, and <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/effort#recommended-effort-levels-for-claude-opus-5-5">Recommended effort levels for Claude Opus 5.5</a> covers this model.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Sampling parameters removed:</strong> Setting <code>temperature</code>, <code>top_p</code>, or <code>top_k</code> to any non-default value on Claude Opus 4.7 and later models, including Claude Opus 5.5, returns a 400 error. The Python SDK (v1.0 and later) does not define them, and passing them raises a <code>TypeError</code>. The safest migration path is to omit these parameters entirely from request payloads. Prompting is the recommended way to guide model behavior on Claude Opus 5.5. If you were using <code>temperature = 0</code> for determinism, note that it never guaranteed identical outputs on prior models.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Thinking content omitted by default:</strong> Thinking blocks still appear in the response stream on Claude Opus 4.7 and later models, but their <code>thinking</code> field is empty unless you explicitly opt in. This is a silent change from Claude Opus 4.6, where the default was to return summarized thinking text. To restore it, see item 4 of <a href="#thinking-in-every-response">Handle thinking in every response</a>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span id="recommended-changes-3"></span><strong>Updated token counting:</strong> Claude Opus 4.7 introduced a new tokenizer, which later Opus models, including Claude Opus 5.5, also use. It contributes to improved performance on a wide range of tasks, and it may use roughly 1x to 1.35x as many tokens when processing text compared to models before Claude Opus 4.7 (up to ~35% more, varying by content).</p>
<p><a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/token-counting"><code>/v1/messages/count_tokens</code></a> returns a different number of tokens for Claude Opus 5.5 than it did for Claude Opus 4.6. Token efficiency can vary by workload shape.</p>
<p>Update your <code>max_tokens</code> parameters to give additional headroom, including compaction triggers, and re-test any code path that estimates tokens client-side or assumes a fixed token-to-character ratio. Use the <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/token-counting">Token counting endpoint</a> to verify. Prompting interventions, <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/task-budgets"><code>task_budget</code></a>, and <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/effort"><code>effort</code></a> can help control costs; these controls may trade off model intelligence.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Prefill removal (already in effect on Claude Opus 4.6):</strong> Prefilling assistant messages returns a 400 error on Claude Opus 4.6 and later Opus models, including Claude Opus 5.5, so this is a change only if you come from Claude Opus 4.5 or earlier. Use <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/structured-outputs">structured outputs</a> or system prompt instructions instead. On Amazon Bedrock, structured outputs aren&#x27;t available for Claude Opus 5.5, so use system prompt instructions there.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="behavior-changes" class="group">Behavior changes<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2kf6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>
<p>Claude Opus 4.7 introduced behavioral differences from Claude Opus 4.6 that are not API breaking changes. These three affect code or scaffolding:</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Built-in progress updates in agentic traces:</strong> Claude Opus 4.7 provides more regular, higher-quality updates to the user throughout long agentic traces. If you&#x27;ve added scaffolding to force interim status messages (&quot;After every 3 tool calls, summarize progress&quot;), try removing it. On Claude Opus 5.5 these updates arrive in <code>thinking</code> blocks, which are empty at the default <code>thinking.display</code>. To receive them, see <a href="#text-between-tool-calls">Text between tool calls is returned in thinking blocks</a>. To shape their length and contents, see <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/prompting-claude-opus-5-5#user-facing-progress-updates">User-facing progress updates</a>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Real-time cybersecurity safeguards:</strong> Newly added in Claude Opus 4.7, requests that involve prohibited or high-risk topics may lead to refusals. For legitimate security work such as penetration testing, vulnerability research, or red-teaming, apply to the <a href="https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14604842-real-time-cyber-safeguards-on-claude-opus-and-sonnet" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Cyber Verification Program</a> to request reduced restrictions. The application route depends on how you access Claude.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>High-resolution image support:</strong> Claude Opus 4.7 is the first Claude model with high-resolution image support. Maximum image resolution is 2,576 pixels on the long edge, up from 1,568 pixels on prior models. This unlocks gains on vision-heavy workloads and is particularly valuable for computer use, screenshot understanding, and document analysis.</p>
<p>High-resolution support is automatic and requires no beta header or client-side opt-in. Two things to plan for:</p>
<ul>
<li>Full-resolution images can use up to approximately 3x more image tokens than on prior models (up to 4,784 tokens per image, compared to the previous cap of roughly 1,600 tokens per image). Re-budget <code>max_tokens</code> and cost expectations for image-heavy workloads, or downsample before sending if you do not need the additional fidelity.</li>
<li>Pointing and bounding-box coordinates returned by the model are 1:1 with actual image pixels on Claude Opus 4.7, so no scale-factor conversion is required.</li>
</ul>
<p>See <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/vision#high-resolution-image-support-on-claude-opus-4-7">High-resolution image support on Claude Opus 4.7</a> for details.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p>For prompt-side differences, see <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/prompting-claude-opus-5-5">Prompting Claude Opus 5.5</a> and <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/claude-prompting-best-practices">Prompting best practices</a>.</p>
<h3 id="migrating-from-claude-opus-45" class="group">Migrating from Claude Opus 4.5 or earlier<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2lf6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>
<p><span id="update-your-model-name-4"></span>If you are migrating from Claude Opus 4.5, Claude Opus 4.1, or an earlier model directly to Claude Opus 5.5, read this page from the top: first work through every earlier section, in page order. Then work through the <a href="#opus-46-breaking-changes">breaking changes for migrating from Claude Opus 4.6</a> earlier in this section. Then apply the following cumulative changes, which took effect between Claude Opus 4.5 and Claude Opus 4.7. If you are on Claude Opus 4.1 or earlier, continue with <a href="#migrating-from-claude-4-1-or-earlier">Migrating from Claude 4.1 or earlier</a> after this subsection.</p>
<h4 id="breaking-changes-from-claude-opus-45" class="group">Breaking changes<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2lv6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h4>
<ol>
<li>
<p><span id="breaking-changes-3"></span><strong>Prefill removal</strong> is covered in the <a href="#opus-46-breaking-changes">breaking changes for migrating from Claude Opus 4.6</a>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Tool parameter quoting:</strong> Claude Opus 4.6 and later models may produce slightly different JSON string escaping in tool call arguments (for example, different handling of Unicode escapes or forward slash escaping). If you parse tool call <code>input</code> as a raw string rather than using a JSON parser, verify your parsing logic. Standard JSON parsers (such as <code>json.loads()</code> or <code>JSON.parse()</code>) handle these differences automatically.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h4 id="recommended-changes-from-claude-opus-45" class="group">Recommended changes<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2mf6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h4>
<p><span id="recommended-changes-4"></span>The first item is required on Claude Opus 5.5; the rest are recommended.</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Migrate to adaptive thinking (required):</strong> <code>thinking: {&quot;type&quot;: &quot;enabled&quot;, &quot;budget_tokens&quot;: N}</code> returns a 400 error on Claude Opus 4.7 and later models. The before and after is item 1 of the <a href="#opus-46-breaking-changes">breaking changes for migrating from Claude Opus 4.6</a>. The migration also moves from <code>client.beta.messages.create()</code> to <code>client.messages.create()</code>: adaptive thinking and effort do not require the beta SDK namespace or any beta headers.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Remove effort beta header:</strong> The effort parameter does not require a beta header. Remove the <code>effort-2025-11-24</code> beta from your requests.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Remove fine-grained tool streaming beta header:</strong> Fine-grained tool streaming does not require a beta header. Remove the <code>fine-grained-tool-streaming-2025-05-14</code> beta from your requests.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Remove interleaved thinking beta header:</strong> With adaptive thinking, interleaved thinking is automatic on every model that supports adaptive thinking. Remove the <code>interleaved-thinking-2025-05-14</code> beta from your requests.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Migrate to output_config.format:</strong> If using structured outputs, update <code>output_format={...}</code> to <code>output_config={&quot;format&quot;: {...}}</code>. The <code>output_format</code> parameter is deprecated and will be removed in the future. To use it anyway, add the <code>structured-outputs-2025-11-13</code> beta header. Without it, the API returns a 400 error. The Python SDK (v1.0 and later) does not accept <code>output_format={...}</code> on <code>client.beta.messages.create()</code> or <code>count_tokens()</code>. The <code>output_format=Model</code> argument of the <code>parse()</code> and <code>stream()</code> helpers is unchanged.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="migrating-from-claude-4-1-or-earlier" class="group">Migrating from Claude 4.1 or earlier<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2n76aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>
<p>If you&#x27;re migrating from Claude Opus 4.1 or earlier models directly to Claude Opus 5.5, first apply everything in <a href="#migrating-from-claude-opus-45">Migrating from Claude Opus 4.5 or earlier</a>. That subsection starts with every earlier section, so in effect you read this page from the top. Then apply the additional changes in this subsection.</p>
<h4 id="additional-breaking-changes" class="group">Additional breaking changes<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2nn6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h4>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Remove sampling parameters:</strong> Covered in <a href="#opus-46-breaking-changes">Sampling parameters removed</a>.</p>

<li>
<p><strong>Update tool versions</strong></p>
<aside data-cds="Aside" data-icon-layout="first-line" role="note" class="flex items-start gap-xs rounded-card px-lg py-md font-sans text-body font-normal bg-warning text-warning shadow-ring-warning [--cds-prose-code-color:currentColor] [--cds-prose-marker-color:currentColor] prose-block [.prose_&amp;]:text-prose print:break-inside-avoid"><span class="flex min-h-[1lh] shrink-0 items-center"><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1.25rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:433.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span><div class="min-w-0 flex-1"><p>This is a breaking change when migrating from Claude 3.x models.</p></div></aside>
<p>Update to the current tool versions. Remove any code using the <code>undo_edit</code> command.</p>

<li>
<p><strong>Verify tool parameter handling (trailing newlines)</strong></p>
<p>Claude 4.5 and later models preserve trailing newlines in tool call string parameters that were previously stripped. If your tools rely on exact string matching against tool call parameters, verify your logic handles trailing newlines correctly.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Update your prompts for behavioral changes</strong></p>
<p>Claude 4 and later models have a more concise, direct communication style and require explicit direction. Review <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/claude-prompting-best-practices">prompting best practices</a> for optimization guidance.</p>
</li>
</ol>

<ul>
<li><strong>Remove legacy beta headers:</strong> Remove <code>token-efficient-tools-2025-02-19</code> and <code>output-128k-2025-02-19</code>. All Claude 4 and later models have built-in token-efficient tool use and these headers have no effect.</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="migrating-from-claude-sonnet-5" class="group">Migrating to Claude Opus 5.5 from Claude Sonnet 5<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2on6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h2>
<p><span id="migrating-to-claude-opus-5-from-claude-sonnet-5"></span>Work through <a href="#request-requirements">What every request to Claude Opus 5.5 must satisfy</a>, <a href="#thinking-in-every-response">Handle thinking in every response</a>, and <a href="#migrating-from-claude-opus-5">Migrating to Claude Opus 5.5 from Claude Opus 5</a>. Use <code>claude-sonnet-5</code> as the model ID you replace. That last section applies to code on Claude Sonnet 5 as written, because Claude Sonnet 5, like Claude Opus 5:</p>
<ul>
<li>Runs with thinking on by default and accepts <code>thinking: {&quot;type&quot;: &quot;disabled&quot;}</code>, in its case at any effort level.</li>
<li>Accepts forced tool choice and the <code>computer_20251124</code> tool.</li>
<li>Returns the text between tool calls as <code>text</code> blocks.</li>
<li>Defaults to <code>high</code> effort.</li>
</ul>
<p><span id="update-your-model-name-5"></span>Manual extended thinking, non-default sampling parameters, and assistant prefill return a 400 error on both models, so nothing changes there. None of the required changes in the sections for Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Opus 4.7, and Claude Opus 4.6 apply to you.</p>
<h3 id="what-changed-from-claude-sonnet-5" class="group">What changed<span class="relative hidden h-[1em] w-0 align-middle lg:inline-block"><button type="button" data-cds="Button" data-cds-icon-only="" data-cds-ghost="" data-size="xs" class="cds-reset group/btn isolate inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap select-none cursor-[var(--cds-cursor-interactive)] aria-disabled:cursor-default data-[disabled]:cursor-default border-0 outline-none focus-visible:outline-hidden [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:outline-hidden rounded h-control font-sans text-body [&amp;:disabled:not([aria-busy])]:opacity-disabled disabled:pointer-events-none transition-shadow duration-fast text-primary font-normal font-control aria-pressed:text-accent focus-visible:shadow-focus [&amp;[data-initial-focus]:focus]:shadow-focus aspect-square w-control px-0 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100" aria-label="Copy link to clipboard" id="_R_2pn6aav5ul5u9febtdpl4plb_" data-base-ui-tooltip-trigger=""><span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -z-[1] rounded-[inherit] inset-0 cds-btn-squish"><span data-cds-part="paint" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-[inherit] transition-[background-color,box-shadow,color] duration-fast ease-out group-focus-visible/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] group-[[data-initial-focus]:focus]/btn:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_var(--cds-page-bg)] bg-transparent group-hover/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-[[aria-haspopup][aria-expanded=true]]/btn:bg-fill-ghost-hover group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent group-hover/btn:group-aria-pressed/btn:bg-accent "></span></span><span class="inline-flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 "><span data-cds="Icon" style="font-size:calc(1rem * var(--cds-rem-scale, 1));font-weight:533.3" aria-hidden="true"></span></span></button></span></h3>
<ol>
<li>
<p><span id="what-changed-2"></span><strong>Mid-conversation system messages:</strong> On the Claude API, Amazon Bedrock, and Google Cloud, Claude Opus 5.5 accepts <code>role: &quot;system&quot;</code> messages immediately after a user turn in the <code>messages</code> array (subject to <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/mid-conversation-system-messages#limitations">placement rules</a>). This feature is not available on Claude Sonnet 5. If you maintain code paths that rebuild the full message history to update instructions, you can simplify them and preserve <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-caching">prompt cache</a> hits on earlier turns.</p>
<!-- -->
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Lower prompt caching minimum:</strong> The minimum cacheable prompt length on Claude Opus 5.5 is 512 tokens, down from 1,024 tokens on Claude Sonnet 5. Prompts that were too short to cache on Claude Sonnet 5 can create cache entries, with no code changes required. See <a href="/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-caching#cache-limitations">Prompt caching</a> for per-model minimums.</p>
</li>
